highlights: Zero-tolerance approach to abuse of any kind
Safer recruitment and rigorous background checks for all adults
Mandatory annual training and clear reporting procedures
Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) in each department
CCTV footage monitoring available upon request for safety or disciplinary purposes
safety.policy_summary: BYIS prioritizes safeguarding every child's wellbeing, protecting students from harm, neglect, abuse, and exploitation in accordance with Thai law and international practices such as the UNCRC and UK Keeping Children Safe in Education (2024). The school implements safer recruitment, background checks, designated safeguarding leads, and a structured complaints and concerns policy.
